messages:
sasha (platform): proposal: split fncall structured-output telemetry into two streams: STRICT rejects (100%) for forensics + SOFT failures (sampled) to stop dashboard noise.
li (eng-telemetry): ok. what's minimal payload for each? we need ingest estimates.
sasha (platform): STRICT: route_id, schema_id, variant, reject_code, request_id, deploy_id, origin, redaction_flag. SOFT: route_id, schema_id, score, snippet_hash, sample_key. keep soft ~1-3%.
maya (privacy): any snippet must be redacted client-side. redact PII, strip >2k chars, never log auth tokens. need approved transforms.
li (eng-telemetry): infra plan: two topics fncall.strict.rejects (no sampling) + fncall.soft.sampled (sampler). tag events fncall.severity. deterministic sampling keyed by route_id+date.
noah (product): UI: show two lines (strict live, soft sampled-smoothed) and example panel that hides raw text unless redaction_flag=true and customer consent. also annotate charts with deploys/schema edits.
sasha (platform): will add deploy_id/git_sha to strict events and origin tag. also add post-validator rule: if SOFT score <0.15 escalate to STRICT for alerting.
ops-bot: drafted alert PLAT-3201: fncall.strict.rejects.rate by route > 0.4% for 5m.
li (eng-telemetry): retention/cost: tag strict with billing_bucket=reject_forensics TTL 90d; soft samples TTL 30d. enterprise opt-in for longer.
sasha (platform): next actions: li open infra PR, maya post redaction rules, noah draft console copy for toggle/opt-in, ops-bot file canary ticket. canary: 10% routes, 48h, rollback if strict_count delta >5% or alert latency regresses.
noah (product): please include estimated cost delta on the rollout page; finance ticket helpful.
ops-bot: created FIN-3301 for cost estimate.
sasha (platform): thanks all — I'll draft and share the rollout doc tomorrow :thumbsup:
